【概述】该工作流程基于最新的万2.1 SCAIL模型，专门针对高质量进行了优化动作转移和角色重制。它允许您将复杂的动作从源视频转移到新角色，同时保持专业级的一致性。

【使用方法】

  1. 参数调整（左侧）：调整基本设置，包括分辨率、视频长度和场景中存在的字符数量。

  2. 角色模式：选择角色是“人类”还是“非人类”（生物/怪物）。

  3. 提示：对您想要的内容提供简单的一句话描述。

  4. 相机运动：如果原始视频有明显的摄像机运动，请启用相机克隆完美匹配的功能。

  5. 角色重制的专业提示：* 对于复杂的角色交换，请参考我的[多角色交换工作流程].

    • 步骤一：使用交换工作流程替换视频剪辑第一帧中的角色。

    • 步骤2：将修改后的帧上传到此工作流程中以进行全视频运动迁移。

【Overview】This workflow is built on the latestWan 2.1 SCAILmodel, specifically optimized for high-qualityMotion TransferandCharacter Remakes. It allows you to transfer complex movements from a source video to new characters while maintaining professional-grade consistency.

【How to Use】

  1. Parameter Tuning (Left Side):Adjust the basic settings including Resolution, Video Length, and the number of characters present in the scene.

  2. Character Mode:Select whether the character is "Human" or "Non-human" (Creatures/Monsters).

  3. Prompting:Provide a simple, one-sentence description of your desired content.

  4. Camera Motion:If the original video has distinct camera movements, enable theCamera Cloningfeature for a perfect match.

  5. Pro Tip for Character Remakes:* For complex character swaps, please refer to my[Multi-Character Swap Workflow].

    • Step 1:Replace the character in the first frame of your video clip using the swap workflow.

    • Step 2:Upload that modified frame into this workflow for full-video motion migration.
